definitions.explanation: The act of concealing true nature or identity by making something appear different. Often used for fraudulent misrepresentation, fake appearances, or military camouflage.

examples.japanese: {偽装|ぎそう}⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧
⟦{産地|さんち}→産地：04031_sanchi⟧{偽装|ぎそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発覚|はっかく}した→発覚する：15423_hakkakusuru⟧。
examples.english: The false labeling of product origin was discovered.

examples.japanese: ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}つからない→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧よう、⟦{車両|しゃりょう}→車両：05297_sharyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{偽装|ぎそう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They camouflaged the vehicles to avoid being spotted by the enemy.

notes:
USAGE: Used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form the verb {偽装|ぎそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to disguise, to falsify, to camouflage).

NUANCE: {偽装|ぎそう} implies deliberate deception—making something appear to be what it is not. It has strongly negative connotations when referring to fraud or falsification.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {偽装|ぎそう}⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧ (sham marriage)
- ⟦{産地|さんち}→産地：04031_sanchi⟧{偽装|ぎそう} (false origin labeling)
- {偽装|ぎそう}⟦{工作|こうさく}→工作：12437_kousaku⟧ (disguise operation)
- {偽装|ぎそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to disguise, falsify)
- {偽装|ぎそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}{抜|ぬ}く→見抜く：06975_minuku⟧ (to see through a disguise)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{装|よそお}う→装う：09152_yosoou⟧ (to pretend, to dress up)
- ⟦{見|み}せかけ→見せかけ：09153_misekake⟧ (pretense, facade)
- カモフラージュ (camouflage - loanword)
